Key result: turn end is thread.session-set leaving 'running', but the final assistant text is dispatched AFTER that event (ProviderRuntimeIngestion.ts:1435 vs :1637-1671), so the runner must debounce on thread.message-sent before reading getThreadDetailSnapshot; assistant text is buffered in memory by default (enableAssistantStreaming=false) and ACP providers carry no item.completed detail fallback. Recommended rule: whole-line case-sensitive /^[ \t]*RALPH_DONE[ \t]*$/m on the last assistant message of the turn, cross-checked against git HEAD movement (mirroring run.sh:322-343), with 'bd ready --parent <epic>' emptiness as the structural stop instead of a .ralph-done file.
